name: pest-control-backend
description: Backend for Pest Control App - Sistema de Control de Plagas

scripts.deploy:prod: powershell "Copy-Item '../.env.production' '.env' -Force; if ($?) { Write-Host 'Production environment set'; node server.js }"
scripts.env:dev: powershell "Copy-Item '../.env.development' '.env' -Force; Write-Host 'Switched to DEVELOPMENT environment' -ForegroundColor Green" && npm run check:config
scripts.env:staging: powershell "Copy-Item '../.env.staging' '.env' -Force; Write-Host 'Switched to STAGING environment' -ForegroundColor Yellow" && npm run check:config
scripts.env:prod: powershell "Copy-Item '../.env.production' '.env' -Force; Write-Host 'Switched to PRODUCTION environment' -ForegroundColor Red" && npm run check:config
scripts.env:local: powershell "Copy-Item '../.env.local' '.env' -Force; Write-Host 'Switched to LOCAL environment' -ForegroundColor Cyan" && npm run check:config
scripts.env:docker: powershell "Copy-Item '../.env.docker' '.env' -Force; Write-Host 'Switched to DOCKER environment' -ForegroundColor Blue" && npm run check:config
scripts.test:connection: node -e "require('./db').query('SELECT NOW()').then(() => console.log('✅ DB Connected')).catch(err => console.error('❌ DB Error:', err.message))"
scripts.test:ssl: powershell "if (Test-Path '../cert.pem') { Write-Host '✅ SSL Certificates found' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '❌ SSL Certificates missing - using HTTP' -ForegroundColor Yellow }"
scripts.test:env: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); console.log('🔍 Environment Test:'); console.log('NODE_ENV:', process.env.NODE_ENV || 'not set'); console.log('ENVIRONMENT:', process.env.ENVIRONMENT || 'not set'); console.log('PORT:', process.env.PORT || 'not set'); console.log('DB_HOST:', process.env.DB_HOST || 'not set');"
scripts.check:config: node -e "const config = require('./config'); console.log('📋 Current Config:'); console.log('Environment:', config.environment); console.log('Port:', config.port); console.log('API URL:', config.apiUrl); console.log('SSL Enabled:', config.ssl ? config.ssl.enabled : 'Not configured'); console.log('DB Host:', config.database ? config.database.host : 'Not configured');"
scripts.check:env: powershell "if (Test-Path '.env') { Get-Content '.env' | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'PASSWORD|SECRET|KEY' } } else { Write-Host 'No .env file found' -ForegroundColor Yellow }"
scripts.check:all-envs: powershell "Write-Host 'Available .env files in parent directory:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Get-ChildItem '../*.env*' | Select-Object Name"
scripts.check:production: npm run check:env && npm run test:ssl && npm run test:connection
scripts.check:security: node -e "const config = require('./config'); console.log('🔒 Security Check:'); console.log('JWT Secret:', config.security && config.security.jwtSecret !== 'fallback-secret-key' ? '✅ Custom' : '⚠️ Default'); console.log('SSL Enabled:', config.ssl && config.ssl.enabled ? '✅ Yes' : '❌ No'); console.log('Environment:', config.environment);"
scripts.validate:all: npm run check:config && npm run test:connection && npm run check:security
scripts.build: powershell "Write-Host 'No build step required for Node.js backend' -ForegroundColor Green"
scripts.lint: powershell "Write-Host 'Linting not configured yet - consider adding ESLint' -ForegroundColor Yellow"
scripts.health: powershell "Write-Host 'Visit https://localhost:8000/api/health for health check' -ForegroundColor Cyan"
scripts.status: powershell "Write-Host 'Visit https://localhost:8000/api/system/status for system status' -ForegroundColor Cyan"
scripts.diagnostics: powershell "Write-Host 'Visit https://localhost:8000/api/diagnostico for full diagnostics' -ForegroundColor Cyan"
scripts.logs:prod: powershell "Write-Host 'Production logs are minimal for security' -ForegroundColor Yellow"
scripts.backup:check: powershell "Write-Host 'DB backup configuration: enabled with 7-day retention' -ForegroundColor Green"
scripts.clean: powershell "if (Test-Path '.env') { Remove-Item '.env' -Force; Write-Host '.env file removed' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'No .env file to clean' -ForegroundColor Yellow }"
scripts.reset:env: npm run clean && powershell "Write-Host 'Environment reset - select new environment with npm run env:xxx' -ForegroundColor Cyan"
scripts.quick:dev: npm run env:dev && powershell "Start-Sleep 1" && npm run dev
scripts.quick:staging: npm run env:staging && powershell "Start-Sleep 1" && npm run dev
scripts.quick:prod: npm run env:prod && powershell "Start-Sleep 1" && npm run start
scripts.list:envs: powershell "Write-Host 'Available .env files in parent directory:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Get-ChildItem '../*.env*' | ForEach-Object { Write-Host '  ' $_.Name -ForegroundColor White }"
scripts.show:structure: powershell "Write-Host 'Project structure:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host 'pestcontrol/' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  backend/ (you are here)' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '  frontend/' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  .env.development' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  .env.staging' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  .env.production' -ForegroundColor Yellow"
scripts.show:current-env: powershell "Write-Host 'Current environment file content:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; if (Test-Path '.env') { Get-Content '.env' | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch 'PASSWORD|SECRET|KEY' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Host '  ' $_ -ForegroundColor White } } else { Write-Host '  No .env file found' -ForegroundColor Red }"
scripts.kill:node: powershell "Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Write-Host 'All Node.js processes stopped' -ForegroundColor Green"
scripts.port:check: powershell "Write-Host 'Checking port 8000:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,State"
scripts.fix:permissions: powershell "Write-Host 'Setting execution policy for current session...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser -Force"
scripts.help: powershell "Write-Host 'Available commands:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  npm run dev:development  - Run in development mode' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  npm run staging          - Quick staging mode' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  npm run prod            - Quick production mode' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  npm run env:dev         - Switch to development env' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  npm run list:envs       - Show available .env files' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  npm run check:config    - Show current configuration' -ForegroundColor White; Write-Host '  npm run validate:all    - Complete validation' -ForegroundColor White"
